transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’ve just gotten really quiet inside. The part of me that used to reach out to people, or enjoy work, yoga, galleries, writing things down… it’s not really there lately. I’m mostly just getting through what I have to do.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
I don’t know if I’d call it depressed. More like… flat, I guess. I’m not sure.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in the things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. The things I used to sort of reach for—work, yoga, going to galleries, even writing in my journal—they just don’t feel like much right now. I still do what I have to do, mostly, but there’s not really any pull toward them.
Have you been feeling sad most days?
Not really sad, no… at least I don’t think so. It’s more like I’m just kind of numb or muted most days.
Did this start after something stressful happened in your life?

I guess… yeah. It seemed to start after we took my older relative into our apartment. That was about eight months ago. Since then things have just felt different with how I’m thinking, work, and being around people.
Have you been feeling this numb or flat nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Yes… pretty much every day. It’s like that part of me that used to want people, or enjoy work, yoga, galleries, even writing… it’s gone very quiet. I’m mostly just getting through what I have to do.
Has this been making it hard for you to function day to day?

Yeah… somewhat. I mean, I’m still going to work, but I’m not really keeping up like I used to. I’ve missed some grant deadlines, and my supervisor has… kind of quietly shifted some of my more demanding clients to other clinicians. So, yes, it’s affecting things.
Even if you don’t feel exactly sad, have you been feeling hopeless?
I don’t know… not exactly hopeless. More like I just don’t expect much to feel different, I guess.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge a lot lately?
Not really… I mean, I get tense sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been anxious or on edge a lot.
Do these feelings seem mainly connected to having your older relative living with you?

Yeah… I think it lines up with that. It’s been about eight months, since they moved in, that I’ve noticed this change in how I’m… thinking and managing things. I don’t know if it’s all because of that, but the timing fits.
When you’re away from home and not around your older relative, do you still feel this same flatness?

Yeah… I think so. Even when I’m not home, it’s still there. It’s like the part of me that used to want to connect with people or enjoy work, yoga, going to galleries… it’s just gone quiet. I mostly just get through what I have to do.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
I don’t know… not unusually, I don’t think. I get worn out sometimes, but I haven’t really been tracking it as low energy exactly.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
Maybe a little, but I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed it as a main problem. I can usually do what I need to do… it just takes some effort sometimes.
Have you noticed your sleep has changed lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear change… I mean, some nights are better than others, but nothing I’ve been paying close attention to.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?
Not really… I haven’t noticed much of a change. My appetite seems about the same, I guess.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty lately?
I don’t think so… not really. I mean, I have moments where I question myself, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling worthless or guilty.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t been having thoughts like that.
When your older relative is away for a few days, does the flatness ease up?

I’m not sure it changes much when they’re away. It’s more… in me, I think. The part of me that used to want to see people, or enjoy work, yoga, going to galleries, even writing things down… it’s just gone very quiet. I still do what I have to do, mostly. It just feels like obligations.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know… not really “depressed” like that. I feel kind of flat a lot, but I wouldn’t say I’m down most of the day nearly every day.
Since this started eight months ago, have there been any stretches of at least two weeks when you felt back to your usual self?
No… I don’t think there’s been a two-week stretch where I felt like myself again. It’s been pretty continuous, I guess, since about eight months ago… since my older relative moved in with us.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a persistent change in mood and functioning beginning after an identifiable psychosocial stressor (an older relative moving into the home), with emotional blunting/anhedonia and mild work impairment. Full criteria for a major depressive episode are not clearly met: the patient does not endorse persistent depressed mood, and other vegetative/cognitive symptoms are largely denied or uncertain, with no suicidality. Recurrent depressive disorder is not supported because there is no history of distinct prior episodes. Work problems are present but appear secondary to the stress-related emotional syndrome rather than the primary diagnosis.
